title: Fire and Rescue NSW name introduced
text: On 1 January 2011, the NSW Fire Brigades changed its name to Fire and Rescue NSW, reflecting the wider range of fire, rescue and emergency services provided to the community.
medalConnection: National Medal, Long Service and Good Conduct awards, bravery and service awards

title: Metropolitan Fire Brigade established in NSW
text: On 14 February 1884, legislation created the Metropolitan Fire Brigade, the organisation from which today's Fire and Rescue NSW traces its official origins.
medalConnection: Fire service long-service, National Medal and bravery awards

title: Origins of NSW Ambulance
text: On 1 April 1895, the Civil Ambulance and Transport Brigade was established, marking the beginning of the first recognised ambulance service in New South Wales.
medalConnection: Ambulance service awards, National Medal and long-service awards

title: State Emergency Services proposed in NSW
text: On 26 April 1955, a NSW Cabinet submission proposed a new government body called the State Emergency Services to coordinate and manage the state's flood response.
medalConnection: National Medal, SES long-service awards and emergency service honours

title: Australian Border Force established
text: On 1 July 2015, the Australian Border Force was established as Australia's operational border control and enforcement organisation, bringing together customs and immigration operational border functions.
medalConnection: Australian Border Force Service Medal, National Medal and predecessor customs and immigration awards

title: NSW Rural Fire Service established
text: On 1 September 1997, the Rural Fires Act 1997 established the NSW Rural Fire Service, building on almost a century of organised rural firefighting in New South Wales.
medalConnection: National Medal, Long Service Medal and rural fire service awards

title: National Police Remembrance Day
text: National Police Remembrance Day commemorates Australian police officers who have lost their lives in the execution of their duty and recognises the service and sacrifice of police across Australia.
medalConnection: National Police Service Medal, National Medal, state and territory police awards and bravery decorations

title: Australian Federal Police begins operations
text: On 19 October 1979, the Australian Federal Police began operations, formed from the Australian Capital Territory Police and Commonwealth Police.
medalConnection: Australian Federal Police Service Medal, National Police Service Medal, National Medal and related honours
